wire_from: NONE — add-state-board's --wire-from needs a node id inside a board and no verified id exists for a role/permission control. Wire it after the follow-up pass below, from the Send-for-review disabled row.
why: The panel computes the user's role and spends it in exactly one place — Send for review's disabledReason (ReviewTab.tsx:146,479). Resolve, Reopen, Reattach, Revoke/Withdraw and Re-send all render live for a VIEWER and are refused by the server after the click. The pattern the codebase already uses (a named disabled reason) sits two lines away. A control that is live for someone who cannot use it is worse than one that is visibly shut.
